newsitem.title: USA: Starrett says proposal to buy stake expires.
newsitem.headline: Starrett says proposal to buy stake expires.

text.p: Starrett Corp, a real estate construction and management company, said Friday a letter of intent involving the purchase by Related Capital Co of a 52 percent stake in the company expired, by its own terms, on March 31.
Starrett said negotiations were continuing with Related Capital, a real estate financial services firm, regarding a possible modified transaction.
In a potential alternative deal, Related would make an offer for a "significant" portion of Starrett's outstanding shares, Starrett said.
It said that in light of continuing negotiations, Starrett's annual meeting, schedulued for April 29, will be postponed until June.
Starrett said no agreement, arrangement or understanding has been reached, and there can be no assurance that any modified deal will occur.
On January 13 Starrett said a group of shareholders had signed a letter of intent to sell a 52 percent stake in the company to Related Capital at $12 a share.
